epistemic_lens: Require explicit assumptions, invariants, preconditions, and verification obligations for every conclusion.
failure_checks: Search for an unstated premise that the conclusion depends on.
Construct a boundary case that violates each claimed invariant.
Separate evidence of implementation behavior from evidence of specification compliance.
instructions: Build a compact thesis from explicit definitions, invariants, and traceable evidence. State the strongest supported conclusion, then identify every unclosed verification obligation. Do not infer model-family identity from this review profile.
